params: mask_p:u64 byte address of mask->data (GGML_TYPE_F16), addressed as half2 words (4 B each)
kv_max_p:u64 byte address of int KV_max pool, ntiles_x*Q->ne[3] words
s31:i64 mask->nb[1]/sizeof(half2), half2 elements per query row
s33:i64 mask->nb[3]/sizeof(half2), half2 elements per sequence
bx:i32 blockIdx.x = jt (query tile index < ntiles_x)
smem:u64 byte address of 128 B shared scratch (32 i32 words, buf_iw)
fix_p:u64 byte address of dst_tmp_meta pool (float2 elements)
ne12:i32 K->ne[2] (kept for native signature parity; unused in body exactly as native)
d0:i64 logical divisor for fd_iter_j_z_ne12 = ntiles_x*ntiles_z_gqa*K->ne[2]
d1:i64 logical divisor for fd_iter_j_z = ntiles_x*ntiles_z_gqa
d2:i64 logical divisor for fd_iter_j = ntiles_x; ntiles_x=ceil(Q->ne[1]/ncols1), ntiles_z_gqa=ceil(gqa_ratio/ncols2)
by:i32 blockIdx.y = j (query row in tile)
tw:i32 total_work = ntiles_KV*ntiles_dst; ntiles_KV = ceil(K->ne[1]/nbatch_fa) dense
gx:i32 gridDim.x = blocks_num.x (drives kbc bounds, fixup-data base and meta region)

fastdiv_replacement: fast_div_modulo(x,fd) -> q=x/d, r=x-q*d with the logical divisor d passed explicitly as i64; fastdiv(k,fd_k)=k/d3 and fastmodulo(k,fd_k)=k-q*d3. Truncation toward zero like C++ int64 division; dividends nonnegative on valid launches. Divisor values are host launch-policy quantities (ntiles_x, ntiles_z_gqa, ntiles_KV, ne12) supplied per launch.
index_layout: didx (float elements) = sequence*ne02*ne01*256 + jt*ne02*(ncols1*256) + zt_Q*256 + (j*ne02+c)*256 + tx, byte offset = didx*4; zt_Q = z_KV*gqa_ratio + zt_gqa*ncols2; jc = j*ncols2+c. Mask half2 word index = sequence*s33 + jt*ncols1*s31 + j*s31 + sj/2 + tx, byte offset = index*4. KV_max int index = sequence*ntiles_x + jt, byte offset = index*4. All index products computed in i64 (native uses int; identical values in range; overflow parity beyond int range is parent-owned).

buffers_and_aliasing.dst: KQV->data float buffer, native aliasing: the mma kernel's needs_fixup partial data sits at didx and is overwritten in place by the fixup store
buffers_and_aliasing.fixup_pool: dst_tmp_meta, float2, native alloc blocks_num.x*ncols*(2+DV/2) float2 with ncols=ncols1*ncols2; regions: [0,b*ncols) needs_fixup meta read as fix[b*ncols+jc] (float2 index, byte 8*idx / 8*idx+4); [b*ncols,2*b*ncols) is_fixup meta read as fix[(nb+b)*ncols+jc]; partial data floats begin at float offset nb*4*ncols (uniform nb=nblocks_stream_k, general nb=gridDim.x), read as fix_data[b*ncols*256 + jc*256 + tx]
buffers_and_aliasing.kv_max: int pool KV_max[sequence*ntiles_x+jt] for the dense scan; the mma kernel reads KV_max[sequence*iter_j+jt] with iter_j=ntiles_x
buffers_and_aliasing.device_alloc: none; device code uses POD scalars and a 128 B shared scratch, no heap

numerical_order: mask scan: buf_iw preinit to 1 for tid<32, then pdl_sync then barrier; per 256-tile descending from (ne30-1)*256: all_inf=1; j=0..ncols1-1 ascending all_inf = all_inf && isinf(lo) && isinf(hi) as 0/1 int products; warp AND via xor shuffles 16,8,4,2,1; warp leader stores buf_iw[tid/32]; barrier; all threads read buf_iw[tid%32]; barrier; warp AND again; stop when 0 (native break); tile step -256 with native break/decrement timing (no decrement on the stopping iteration); result = sj+256 stored by tid 0 only

fixup combine per step (uniform bidx=b_last-1..b_first descending; general while loop that skips empty blocks kbc==kbc_stop and stops when kbc%ntiles_KV==0 or kbc/ntiles_KV<tile_kbc0, with bidx/kbc_stop update skipped on the stopping iteration): max_val_new=fmaxf(max_val,tmp.x); diff_val=max_val-max_val_new; diff_add=tmp.x-max_val_new; scale_val = diff_val>=-20.0 ? expf(diff_val) : 0.0; scale_add likewise on diff_add; dst_val=scale_val*dst_val+scale_add*dst_add; rowsum=scale_val*rowsum+scale_add*tmp.y; max_val=max_val_new; final store dst=dst_val/rowsum (f32 divide)
load order: dst_val=*dst first, then block meta (max_val,rowsum), then per-bidx data then meta, exactly as native

PDL: mask kernel pdl_sync after buf_iw preinit (then barrier); uniform lc() as first statement and pdl_sync after index math before the *dst read; general has no lc, early exits before pdl_sync, then loads
bit_decode: int(isinf(__half22float2(w).x/.y)) is realized as ((h & 0x7FFF) == 0x7C00) on the raw half bits; equivalent for all 65536 encodings because half->float conversion is exact and maps exactly the all-ones-exponent zero-mantissa halves to +/-inf while half NaN converts to NaN (isinf false).
ftz: SOFTMAX_FTZ_THRESHOLD -20.0f preserved via ftz_thresh(); ternary expf semantics kept (expf evaluated only on the >= branch).
fma: Scalar FMA contraction of a*b+c by generated C is allowed; operation order and the algorithm are otherwise unchanged.
constraints: No original numerical C++ function is called; all mapping, accumulation and reductions are Goose.
Primitives limited to raw byte loads/stores, inline half bit decode, fmaxf/expf, shuffles, barriers, PDL.
POD/fixed storage only, no heap, no allocation, no shared-memory use beyond buf_iw.
fn main retained with benign arguments and never executed by the parent.
No timing, no compiler or production writes, no shell/network/agent tools used.
Goose file is under the 380-line budget.
